title: Claims list shows a stale status after approval
body:
### Summary

The claims list keeps showing a claim's old status after a caseworker changes it.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Sign in as the seeded claimant with one submitted claim.
2. As the seeded caseworker, approve that claim.
3. As the claimant, reload the claims list.

### Expected behaviour

The claim shows "Approved".

### Actual behaviour

The claim shows "Submitted" until the claimant signs out and back in.

### Completion Goal

1. [screenshot] state: `/claims` as the seeded claimant after the caseworker approved the claim; expected: the claim shows "Approved" on the next page load
2. [api-trace] state: GET /api/claims as the seeded claimant after the approval; expected: the claim's status is approved

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 2 criteria

### Scenario

Approve the seeded claimant's submitted claim as the caseworker, then reload the claimant's claims list and call GET /api/claims as the claimant.

### Environment

local app with the seeded synthetic claimant and caseworker; never production
